'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nick Smarcz LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Smarcz]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Vandelay Industries
* '''Username:''' Smarticus
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
